apps.title: Dataset overview
apps.goal: See all 64 reports at a glance — categories, years, and a filterable catalogue.

apps.title: Project folders
apps.goal: Meet the reports as a side-on archive, then file them into magazine folders by theme, year, or project type.

apps.title: Methods fan
apps.goal: See how each research method links into category nodes, then focus a category to fan its reports out above it.

apps.title: Report timeline
apps.goal: See when associate reports were published and how project citations and author successions connect them.

apps.title: Year × project type
apps.goal: See how report types sit across time, coloured by research theme.

apps.title: Report search
apps.goal: Find reports by meaning: typed queries become method, year, and category filters plus ranked full-text.
